notes: Each rear section fastens directly to the new front. No glue or separate seam joining plates.
Upper and lower sections print with their respective flat exterior faces on the bed.
Transition prints on its upper transverse cut end, Y=55.1, with a brim. Its broad curved outside is no longer a support-contact surface.
TP4056 locating bay crosses the upper joint; the battery bay does not. Assemble the sections and check the bay before seating the charger PCB.
Only the connector FASTENER passages shrink. USB-C body opening, flange pocket, adjustable hole pitch and switch actuator opening stay unchanged.
CAD checks are not physical fit, PETG strength, screw torque or printer validation.
